LEGISLATIVE INTERIM STUDY COMMITTEE —— IOWA 4 EDUCATION SUMMIT. 5 1. The legislative council is requested to establish an 6 interim study committee to meet during the 2025 legislative 7 interim to plan an Iowa education summit to be held in 2026. 8 The interim study committee shall do all of the following: 9 a. Determine a potential location, time, date, and agenda 10 for the Iowa education summit. 11 b. Study and determine educational leaders and presenters 12 who could speak during the Iowa education summit and provide 13 information related to best practices in education, including 14 but not limited to any of the following: 15 (1) Active learning. 16 (2) Differentiated instruction. 17 (3) Formative assessments. 18 (4) Providing constructive feedback. 19 (5) Using technology. 20 (6) Encouraging student, family, and community 21 participation. 22 c. Develop a list of prospective guest speakers and keynote 23 speakers for the Iowa education summit, which may include but 24 is not limited to any of the following: 25 (1) Academics. 26 (2) Practitioners. 27 (3) Elected officials. 28 (4) Students. 29 (5) Parents. 30 d.
